title.narrative: Implementing a National Climate Finance Mechanism and strengthening Ecuador Zero Carbon Program.

description.narrative: Goal: This readiness proposal aims to contribute to increasing climate action by enhancing strategic frameworks for accessing long-term international climate finance and consolidating the PECC, a voluntary carbon quantification, reduction, and compensation mechanism for climate change mitigation.Long-term international climate finance flows to Ecuador will be secured through the design and implementation of a new climate finance vehicle in benefit of both public and private sectors. • The PECC will be strengthened through increasing the participation of private stakeholders committed to climate change mitigation through sustainable production and consumption practices.

This proposal aims to boost the mobilization of climate finance in Ecuador through a national financing vehicle and strengthen Ecuador Zero Carbon Program (PECC) to raise climate change mitigation ambition.By the end of this proposal:• Ecuador will have developed and implemented a new national climate finance vehicle.• Ecuador will have strengthened its PECC.
